assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square original card portrait for a painted fantasy strategy game
Primary request: A distinct portrait of Thornscouts, exactly four woodland pathfinder fighters with leaf-shaped masks and light blades.
Scene/backdrop: A shallow-focus woodland trail, with soft amber light and broad tree trunks behind them.
Subject: Four small, nimble scouts in a tight recognizable squad. Each has a pale green leaf-shaped half-mask with simple vein grooves, not a carved wooden face. Their outfits are warm russet and sand-colored wrap jackets with short, practical shoulder capes and thin dark belts; keep leaf material only in the masks and a few ties. Each scout carries one short, narrow, single-edged blade, with different stances and visible blade silhouettes. One leans forward, one turns to watch the path, one crouches at the side, and one stands behind with a blade held low. Their faces are mostly hidden by the masks.
Style/medium: Hand-painted fantasy card illustration with sculpted forms, broad controlled brushwork, softened surface detail, matte shading, clean readable silhouettes, and warm atmospheric depth. Use the same polished painterly finish as the existing original card portraits, while making these designs clearly new.
Composition/framing: Square close group portrait from thigh-up; four full heads and all four blades visible. The group fills the frame but stays separated enough to read at small card size; no scout overlaps another scout's face or weapon.
Lighting/mood: Warm upper-left forest light; alert and agile.
Color palette: Pale leaf green, russet cloth, bark brown, muted steel, amber highlights.
Materials/textures: Veined leaf masks, linen wraps, leather ties, lightly worn iron blades, softly painted foliage.
Text (verbatim): None.
Constraints: Exactly four original scouts, all with one light blade. Keep leaf motifs confined mainly to masks. Distinct silhouettes and poses. No symbols, captions, letters, UI, borders, or logos.
Avoid: Copying any known game character or existing project portrait; wooden face masks; full leaf armor; archery; bows; crossbows; daggers in both hands; large shields; mechanical parts; excess extra figures; oversized leaves covering faces; photorealism; glossy 3D plastic; flat vector art; text.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square original card portrait for a painted fantasy strategy game
Primary request: A distinct portrait for Forgeguard, exactly five stocky sentries from a small copper foundry, each armed with either a hand hammer or a compact axe.
Scene/backdrop: A softly blurred riverside workshop interior with furnace glow and dark timber beams.
Subject: Five squat, broad-shouldered, living sentries in copper scale aprons over ember-red work jackets. Their armor is hand-forged copper with simple flat planes and riveted edges; use short leather caps or open brow bands so several human faces and beards are visible. Give each guard a different practical weapon: three small smithing hammers and two short chopping axes, held low or upright. Their expressions are steady and neighborly rather than fierce. Build a clustered team silhouette with one guard at center and two on either side, no weapons covering faces.
Style/medium: Hand-painted fantasy card illustration with softly sculpted forms, controlled brushwork, matte materials, warm highlights, simplified readable shapes, and the polished atmospheric finish of existing original card portraits. Keep the figures painterly rather than photographic.
Composition/framing: Square close group portrait from waist-up, exactly five guards; heads and all five weapon heads visible, group fills the frame and remains readable when reduced to a small card.
Lighting/mood: Warm top-front-left forge light balanced by cool ambient workshop shadow; dependable, sturdy, unhurried.
Color palette: Burnished copper, charcoal iron, ember-red cloth, dark leather, amber light, muted wood.
Materials/textures: Hammered copper plates, rivets, quilted cloth, leather ties, worn iron hammer and axe heads, lightly painted workshop background.
Text (verbatim): None.
Constraints: Exactly five original living guards. Clearly stocky, compact silhouettes. Weapons are only small hammers and compact axes. No symbols, captions, letters, UI, borders, or logos.
Avoid: Real-game characters or recognizable designs, robotic bodies, gears, glowing eyes, clockwork joints, ornate crowns, broad shields, long swords, extra figures, oversized weapons, photorealism, glossy 3D plastic, flat vector art, text.
